programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Doctor Jonathan ‘J-Pap’ Papson puzzles over a power boat racer who’s had a high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey resets a dislocated shoulder.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emmanuel Karpathakis fear a cyclist with glass sticking out of his neck could bleed out. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
